title: Goodhart's Law Severity as a Function of Proxy Reward Specificity

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly tests a refinement of Goodhart's Law by distinguishing proxy specificity as a variable. If specificity predicts Goodhart onset speed, this provides concrete guidance for reward design in alignment: prefer less specific proxies. Actionable and well-grounded.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Running PPO with three different reward functions on a text generation task requires RLHF infrastructure. Training a reward model is one of the three proxies. Human evaluation for ground truth quality adds logistical complexity. This is demanding for beginners even with medium compute.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Three proxy rewards, PPO training for each, human evaluation at multiple checkpoints. Each PPO run is itself a substantial project. The three-way comparison with human evaluation makes this too broad for 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
